# Sentence structure

> **这页管什么**：**条件写在指令前面。** 这一页只有这一条规则，但它是整份指南最有用的一条之一。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/sentence-structure> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## Conditions before instructions

Mention the circumstance, condition, or goal **before** you provide the instruction.

Rationale: it lets the reader skip the instruction if it doesn't apply to them.

## Examples

- Recommended: "**For more information**, see [link]."
- Not recommended: "See [link] for more information."

- Recommended: "**To delete the entire document**, click **Delete**."
- Not recommended: "Click **Delete** to delete the entire document."

For longer conditions (a list of regions, a set of prerequisites), still lead with the condition rather than burying it at the end of the sentence.

## Applied to procedures

See: procedures — the same principle governs step order and step wording.
